CREATE TABLE traces ON CLUSTER default (

    `release` Nullable(String),

m:clustered/0019_analytics_traces.up.sql.query:
CREATE VIEW analytics_traces ON CLUSTER default AS
SELECT
    project_id,
    toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS hour,
    uniq(id) AS countTraces,
    max(user_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasUsers,
    max(session_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasSessions,
    max(if(environment != {p1:String}, {p2:Int64}, {p3:Int64})) AS hasEnvironments,
    max(length(tags) > {p4:Int64}) AS hasTags
FROM
    traces
WHERE toStartOfHour(timestamp) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), {p5:Int64}))
GROUP BY
    project_id,
    hour

m:clustered/0020_analytics_observations..query:
CREATE VIEW analytics_observations ON CLUSTER default AS
SELECT
    project_id,
    type,
    toStartOfHour(start_time) AS hour,
    uniq(id) AS countObservations,
    max(level != {p1:String}) AS hasLevel,
    max(provided_model_name IS NOT NULL) AS hasProvidedModelName,
    max(length(provided_usage_details) > {p2:Int64}) AS hasProvidedUsageDetails,
    max(length(provided_cost_details) > {p3:Int64}) AS hasProvidedCostDetails,
    max(prompt_name IS NOT NULL) AS hasPromptName
FROM
    observations
WHERE toStartOfHour(start_time) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), {p4:Int64}))
GROUP BY
    project_id,
    type,
    hour

(
     
    `project_id`         String,

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS traces_7d_amt_mv ON CLUSTER default TO traces_7d_amt AS
SELECT
     
    tn.project_id                                                                              as project_id,
    tn.id                                                                                      as id,
    min(tn.start_time)                                                                         as timestamp,   
    min(tn.start_time)                                                                         as start_time,
    max(coalesce(tn.end_time, tn.start_time))                                                  as end_time,
    anyLast(tn.name)                                                                           as name,

     
    maxMap(tn.metadata)                                                                        as metadata,
    anyLast(tn.user_id)                                                                        as user_id,
    anyLast(tn.session_id)                                                                     as session_id,
    anyLast(tn.environment)                                                                    as environment,
    groupUniqArrayArray(tn.tags)                                                               as tags,
    anyLast(tn.version)                                                                        as version,
    anyLast(tn.release)                                                                        as release,

     
    argMaxState(tn.bookmarked, if(tn.bookmarked is not null, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p1:Int64}, {p2:Int64}))) as bookmarked,
    argMaxState(tn.public, if(tn.public is not null, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p3:Int64}, {p4:Int64})))         as public,

     
    groupUniqArrayArray(tn.observation_ids)                                                    as observation_ids,
    groupUniqArrayArray(tn.score_ids)                                                          as score_ids,
    sumMap(tn.cost_details)                                                                    as cost_details,
    sumMap(tn.usage_details)                                                                   as usage_details,

     
    argMaxState(tn.input, if(tn.input <> {p5:String}, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p6:Int64}, {p7:Int64})))                 as input,
    argMaxState(tn.output, if(tn.output <> {p8:String}, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p9:Int64}, {p10:Int64})))               as output,

    min(tn.created_at)                                                                         as created_at,
    max(tn.updated_at)                                                                         as updated_at
FROM traces_null tn
GROUP BY project_id, id

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS traces_all_amt_mv ON CLUSTER default TO traces_all_amt AS
SELECT
     
    tn.project_id                                                                              as project_id,
    tn.id                                                                                      as id,
    min(tn.start_time)                                                                         as timestamp,   
    min(tn.start_time)                                                                         as start_time,
    max(coalesce(tn.end_time, tn.start_time))                                                  as end_time,
    anyLast(tn.name)                                                                           as name,

     
    maxMap(tn.metadata)                                                                        as metadata,
    anyLast(tn.user_id)                                                                        as user_id,
    anyLast(tn.session_id)                                                                     as session_id,
    anyLast(tn.environment)                                                                    as environment,
    groupUniqArrayArray(tn.tags)                                                               as tags,
    anyLast(tn.version)                                                                        as version,
    anyLast(tn.release)                                                                        as release,

     
    argMaxState(tn.bookmarked, if(tn.bookmarked is not null, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p1:Int64}, {p2:Int64}))) as bookmarked,
    argMaxState(tn.public, if(tn.public is not null, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p3:Int64}, {p4:Int64})))         as public,

     
    groupUniqArrayArray(tn.observation_ids)                                                    as observation_ids,
    groupUniqArrayArray(tn.score_ids)                                                          as score_ids,
    sumMap(tn.cost_details)                                                                    as cost_details,
    sumMap(tn.usage_details)                                                                   as usage_details,

     
    argMaxState(tn.input, if(tn.input <> {p5:String}, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p6:Int64}, {p7:Int64})))                 as input,
    argMaxState(tn.output, if(tn.output <> {p8:String}, tn.event_ts, toDateTime64({p9:Int64}, {p10:Int64})))               as output,

    min(tn.created_at)                                                                         as created_at,
    max(tn.updated_at)                                                                         as updated_at
FROM traces_null tn
GROUP BY project_id, id

    max(data_type = {p5:String}) AS hasNumericScore,
    max(data_type = {p6:String}) AS hasCategoricalScore,

    sumMap(map(concat(if(ingestion_sdk_name = {p7:String}, {p8:String}, ingestion_sdk_name), {p9:String}, if(ingestion_sdk_version = {p10:String}, {p11:String}, ingestion_sdk_version)), toUInt64({p12:Int64}))) AS ingested_sdks
FROM
    scores
WHERE toStartOfHour(timestamp) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), {p13:Int64}))
GROUP BY
    project_id,

    cost_details Map(LowCardinality(String), Decimal({p18:Int64},{p19:Int64})),

    )
)

    cost_details Map(LowCardinality(String), Decimal({p10:Int64},{p11:Int64})),
    calculated_input_cost Decimal({p12:Int64}, {p13:Int64}) MATERIALIZED arraySum(mapValues(mapFilter(x -> positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p14:String}) > {p15:Int64}, cost_details))),
    calculated_output_cost Decimal({p16:Int64}, {p17:Int64}) MATERIALIZED arraySum(mapValues(mapFilter(x -> positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p18:String}) > {p19:Int64}, cost_details))),
    calculated_total_cost Decimal({p20:Int64}, {p21:Int64}) MATERIALIZED arraySum(mapValues(mapFilter(x -> positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p22:String}) > {p23:Int64} OR positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p24:String}) > {p25:Int64}, cost_details))),
    total_cost Decimal({p26:Int64}, {p27:Int64}) ALIAS cost_details[{p28:String}],

    telemetry_sdk_name String,

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events_core
(

    name String,

    is_app_root Bool DEFAULT {p5:Bool},

     
    bookmarked Bool DEFAULT {p6:Bool},
    public Bool DEFAULT {p7:Bool},

     
    prompt_id String,
    prompt_name String,
    prompt_version Nullable(UInt16),

     
    model_id String,
    provided_model_name String,
    model_parameters String,

     
    provided_usage_details Map(LowCardinality(String), UInt64),
    usage_details Map(LowCardinality(String), UInt64),
    provided_cost_details Map(LowCardinality(String), Decimal({p8:Int64},{p9:Int64})),
    cost_details Map(LowCardinality(String), Decimal({p10:Int64},{p11:Int64})),
    calculated_input_cost Decimal({p12:Int64}, {p13:Int64}) MATERIALIZED arraySum(mapValues(mapFilter(x -> positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p14:String}) > {p15:Int64}, cost_details))),
    calculated_output_cost Decimal({p16:Int64}, {p17:Int64}) MATERIALIZED arraySum(mapValues(mapFilter(x -> positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p18:String}) > {p19:Int64}, cost_details))),
    calculated_total_cost Decimal({p20:Int64}, {p21:Int64}) MATERIALIZED arraySum(mapValues(mapFilter(x -> positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p22:String}) > {p23:Int64} OR positionCaseInsensitive(x.1, {p24:String}) > {p25:Int64}, cost_details))),
    total_cost Decimal({p26:Int64}, {p27:Int64}) ALIAS cost_details[{p28:String}],

    usage_pricing_tier_id Nullable(String),
    usage_pricing_tier_name Nullable(String),

     
    tool_definitions Map(String, String),
    tool_calls Array(String),
    tool_call_names Array(String),

     
    input String,
    input_length UInt64 MATERIALIZED lengthUTF8(input),
    output String,
    output_length UInt64 MATERIALIZED lengthUTF8(output),

     
    metadata_names Array(String),
    metadata_values Array(String),

     
    experiment_id String,
    experiment_name String,
    experiment_metadata_names Array(String),
    experiment_metadata_values Array(String),
    experiment_description String,
    experiment_dataset_id String,
    experiment_item_id String,
    experiment_item_version Nullable(DateTime64({p29:Int64})),
    experiment_item_expected_output String,
    experiment_item_metadata_names Array(String),
    experiment_item_metadata_values Array(String),
    experiment_item_root_span_id String,

     
    source LowCardinality(String),
    service_name String,
    service_version String,
    scope_name String,
    scope_version String,
    telemetry_sdk_language LowCardinality(String),
    telemetry_sdk_name String,
    telemetry_sdk_version String,

     
    blob_storage_file_path String,
    event_bytes UInt64,
    created_at DateTime64({p30:Int64}) DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at DateTime64({p31:Int64}) DEFAULT now(),
    event_ts DateTime64({p32:Int64}),
    is_deleted UInt8,

     
    INDEX idx_span_id span_id TYPE bloom_filter({p33:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p34:Int64},
    INDEX idx_trace_id trace_id TYPE bloom_filter({p35:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p36:Int64},

    INDEX idx_session_id session_id TYPE bloom_filter({p39:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p40:Int64},
    INDEX idx_created_at created_at TYPE minmax GRANULARITY {p41:Int64},
    INDEX idx_updated_at updated_at TYPE minmax GRANULARITY {p42:Int64},
    INDEX idx_provided_model_name provided_model_name TYPE bloom_filter({p43:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p44:Int64},
    INDEX idx_experiment_id experiment_id TYPE bloom_filter({p45:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p46:Int64},
    INDEX idx_metadata_names metadata_names TYPE bloom_filter({p47:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p48:Int64},
    INDEX idx_fts_metadata_values metadata_values TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha),
    INDEX idx_fts_metadata_names metadata_names TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha)
)
ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(event_ts, is_deleted)
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(start_time)

CREATE VIEW analytics_scores AS

    project_id,
    toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS hour,
    uniq(id) AS countScores,
    max(source = {p1:String}) AS hasAnnotation,
    max(source = {p2:String}) AS hasApi,
    max(source = {p3:String}) AS hasEval,
    max(observation_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasObservationScore,

    max(dataset_run_id IS NOT NULL) AS hasDatasetRunScore,
    max(data_type = {p4:String}) AS hasBoolScore,
    max(data_type = {p5:String}) AS hasNumericScore,
    max(data_type = {p6:String}) AS hasCategoricalScore,
    max(comment IS NOT NULL) AS hasComment
FROM
    scores
WHERE toStartOfHour(timestamp) <= toStartOfHour(subtractHours(now(), {p7:Int64}))
GROUP BY

    hour;

(

    `id`                 String,
    `timestamp`          SimpleAggregateFunction(min, DateTime64({p1:Int64})),   
    `start_time`         SimpleAggregateFunction(min, DateTime64({p2:Int64})),
    `end_time`           SimpleAggregateFunction(max, Nullable(DateTime64({p3:Int64}))),
    `name`               SimpleAggregateFunction(anyLast, Nullable(String)),

     
    `metadata`           SimpleAggregateFunction(maxMap, Map(String, String)),
    `user_id`            SimpleAggregateFunction(anyLast, Nullable(String)),
    `session_id`         SimpleAggregateFunction(anyLast, Nullable(String)),

    `public`             AggregateFunction(argMax, Nullable(Bool), DateTime64({p5:Int64})),

     
    `observation_ids`    SimpleAggregateFunction(groupUniqArrayArray, Array(String)),
    `score_ids`          SimpleAggregateFunction(groupUniqArrayArray, Array(String)),
    `cost_details`       SimpleAggregateFunction(sumMap, Map(String, Decimal({p6:Int64}, {p7:Int64}))),
    `usage_details`      SimpleAggregateFunction(sumMap, Map(String, UInt64)),

     
    `input`       AggregateFunction(argMax, String, DateTime64({p8:Int64})) CODEC (ZSTD({p9:Int64})),
    `output`      AggregateFunction(argMax, String, DateTime64({p10:Int64})) CODEC (ZSTD({p11:Int64})),
